name: Charm Care Corporation
summary: Charm Care Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides nursing care services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Nursing Care and Other Businesses. The company develops, manages, and operates nursing care homes and residential nursing homes. It is also involved in the temporary staffing, recruitment, and home nursing businesses. The company was formerly known as Fuji Clinic Laboratory Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Charm Care Corporation in December 2007. Charm Care Corporation was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
